suites.name: contract
suites.description: The tool inventory a model is offered, and what it promises.

checks.title: exposes exactly the eight documented tools
checks.guards: A tool that exists but is undocumented gets used by guesswork.

checks.title: every tool describes itself in more than a label
checks.guards: Selection between eight tools is made from these strings alone.

checks.title: the node schema offers no place to put coordinates
checks.guards: Hand-supplied geometry is what produces the overlapping boxes.

checks.title: update_diagram announces that it overwrites, and names the tool to run first
checks.guards: Silent wholesale replacement of a hand-drawn sheet is unrecoverable.

checks.title: edit_sheet_text points at itself as the safe path for a drawn sheet
checks.guards: Otherwise every wording fix reaches for the tool that regenerates layout.

checks.title: validate_spec needs no workspace, so it cannot write anywhere
checks.guards: A dry run that could write is not a dry run.

suites.name: generation
suites.description: A coordinate-free spec becomes a diagram that renders cleanly.

checks.title: a valid spec creates a sheet and returns a link to it
checks.guards: Without the link the user cannot find what was just made.

checks.title: one shape per node in the spec
checks.guards: A dropped participant is a diagram that lies about the system.

checks.title: one arrow per edge in the spec
checks.guards: A dropped edge is a connection the reader will not know exists.

checks.title: every node label appears in the scene
checks.guards: Boxes without their labels are the failure this tool replaces.

checks.title: every arrow is bound to a shape at both ends
checks.guards: Unbound arrows detach the moment anyone moves a box in the editor.

checks.title: the generated scene passes its own structural validator
checks.guards: Broken bindings and spilled text render as a visibly wrong diagram.

checks.title: no two node boxes overlap
checks.guards: Overlapping boxes are the single most common hand-written-JSON defect.

checks.title: a spec title becomes a title element
checks.guards: An untitled sheet in a list of sheets is unidentifiable.

checks.title: the element count in the reply matches the sheet that was written
checks.guards: A model relays this number to the user; a wrong one is a quiet lie.

checks.title: read_sheet reports back every participant it just wrote
checks.guards: Extending an existing diagram starts by reading it.

suites.name: privacy
suites.description: Nothing readable leaves the machine, and the passcode is never requested.

checks.title: no node label, edge label, or title appears in any request body
checks.guards: This is the entire end-to-end encryption claim. If it fails, the claim is false.

checks.title: the sheet name sent to the server is the [encrypted] sentinel
checks.guards: Sheet names are content: a dashboard of readable titles leaks the whole map.

checks.title: the blob the server stored decrypts back to the diagram
checks.guards: Sending nothing readable is only useful if the real content is in there.

checks.title: the workspace id is sent, but no diagram content rides along with it
checks.guards: Metadata leaks are how "encrypted" products turn out to be readable.

checks.title: a locked read returns the exact unlock command instead of an opaque error
checks.guards: An unexplained failure gets retried forever or reported as a broken product.

checks.title: the message says the same tool can simply be retried afterwards
checks.guards: Otherwise the model tells the user to restart Claude, which is not needed.

checks.title: the message forbids asking the user for their passcode
checks.guards: The passcode is the account master secret. A model that asks for it puts it in a transcript, which is exactly what the out-of-band unlock exists to prevent.

checks.title: listing still returns ids while names stay unreadable
checks.guards: A locked account should be navigable, not bricked.

suites.name: recovery
suites.description: Bad calls are refused with enough information to fix them.

checks.title: a dangling edge is refused by naming the node that is missing
checks.guards: Without the name, the fix is a guess and the model retries blind.

checks.title: a refused create leaves no sheet behind
checks.guards: A half-created diagram is worse than none — nobody knows it is there.

checks.title: the corrected spec the message implies is accepted
checks.guards: A refusal that cannot be satisfied is a dead end dressed as guidance.

checks.title: validate_spec reports the duplicate id and the dangling edge
checks.guards: Checking before writing is only worth doing if it finds what writing would.

checks.title: validate_spec creates nothing
checks.guards: A dry run with side effects is a trap.

checks.title: one unmatched find leaves every element untouched
checks.guards: A partially applied edit is invisible until someone re-reads the sheet.

checks.title: the refusal reports that nothing was written
checks.guards: Silence here reads as success and the wrong text ships.

checks.title: a successful edit changes the text and no coordinate
checks.guards: Rewriting a label must not silently redraw a hand-placed diagram.

checks.title: importing a file that is not there explains itself instead of crashing
checks.guards: A stack trace here tells the model nothing it can act on.
